jobs.title: System Administrator with Google Workspace Experience
jobs.description: About the Role We are looking for a Google Workspace (GWS) System Administrator to manage, maintain, and optimize enterprise Google Workspace environments. In this role, you will handle user lifecycle operations, establish security policies, configure identity and access management (IAM), and monitor domain logs to ensure seamless collaboration and data security. Key Responsibilities GWS & IAM Administration: Manage user provisioning, group configurations, organizational units (OUs), licensing, and role-based access control (RBAC). Policy & Security Governance: Implement, update, and enforce workspace policies, including Data Loss Prevention (DLP), multi-factor authentication (2FA/MFA), session controls, and email security protocols (SPF, DKIM, DMARC). Audit, Logs & Monitoring: Monitor audit logs, track platform security alerts, investigate operational anomalies, and generate compliance reports. Incident & Operational Support: Troubleshoot identity, calendar, drive, and email routing issues; provide escalated tier-2/tier-3 administrative support. Platform Enhancement: Support administration across connected workspace tools and enterprise features (e.g., Chrome Enterprise, Google Gemini Enterprise integrations).

jobs.title: Senior IT Procurement Specialist
jobs.description: Job Title: Senior IT Procurement Specialist (Vendor Management) Location: Makati, Philippines (Hybrid – 3 days onsite and 2 days remote per week) Employment Type: Permanent Working hours: CET business hours About Us: Hubexo provides cutting-edge data, insights, and software solutions to the global construction industry. Founded in Sweden in 1936, Hubexo specializes in project information, eTendering, product information, market intelligence, and specification. With operations in more than 20 countries and a workforce of 2,500 employees, Hubexo helps its customers sell more efficiently, build sustainably, and lead the future of construction innovation. In Philippines, Hubexo operates under the legal name BCI Central. Our Values: Dream big - Embrace ambitious goals and strive to exceed expectations, every day. Thrive together - Collaborate, communicate, and celebrate success. Own it - Take ownership of your work and empower yourself to make a difference. Do the right thing - Stand firm in your values and let integrity guide your actions at every turn. About the role: We’re looking for a Senior IT Procurement Specialist to lead key sourcing and vendor management initiatives across our growing IT landscape. You’ll ensure we get the best value from our suppliers — not just in cost, but in performance, reliability, and innovation. If you’re a seasoned negotiator who knows how to balance business, technology, and supplier relationships, this role is for you. What You’ll Do Drive IT sourcing strategies and contract negotiations across hardware, software, cloud, and services. Manage vendor relationships, performance, and governance to ensure delivery excellence. Partner with IT, Finance, and Legal to align vendor spend with business goals. Analyze market trends and identify opportunities for cost optimization and innovation. Support procurement transformation and process improvement initiatives. Track and report procurement metrics to improve visibility and decision-making.
